content:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: elevated 5xx + timeout rate on /v1/generate (prod-us-east-1)
- metric blip started ~2026-03-15T11:21Z
- p95: 3.2s -> 9.8s, p99: 8s -> 18s
- 502/504 ~ 7% of requests, UEs and hosted API traffic affected
- grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/generation-slo (stacked panels)

maya: taking this, i'm oncall. paging SREs and runtime.

raj: seeing the same in traces — large "wait_for_connection" and "kv_cache_miss" spikes right after deploy.

lina: that deploy was `model-service v2.3.0` with batching/kernel tweak. rolled at 2026-03-15T11:20Z by me.

maya: sounds like a regression window lines up with deploy. plan: canary rollback -> full rollback if canary shows fail.

deploy-bot: deploy-2026-03-15-11:20 completed. Canary 10%.

lina: i'm standing by to rollback if needed. logs show a lot of keepalive closes from the proxy.

raj: quick telemetry: connection pool occupancy -> 100% at spike, backlog queue length up 4-6x. hypothesis: new kernel param changed accept backlog behaviour under high multiplexing.

maya: initiate rollback (canary).

maya: ```bash
# rollback command
deployctl rollback --env prod-us-east-1 --service model-service --to release-2026-03-14-23
```

deploy-bot: rollback initiated by maya at 2026-03-15T11:35Z (canary -> previous release).

support-bot: creating incident page and customer notification draft. tagging CS for top-hit orgs.

paul: i'm taking traffic routing changes — will shepherd affected AZ out of LB.

paul: ```bash
# quick traffic shift
routectl set-weight --env prod-us-east-1 --service api-gateway --region us-east-1b --weight 0.1
kubectl cordon node-az-b-*/ --context prod-cluster
```

lina: digging into runtime logs: many `TLS_read: connection reset by peer` and `http2: stream error` around the same window. keepalives dropping + kv cache miss causing longer tails.

raj: adding correlation: high kv cache miss -> longer latency -> more inflight connections -> pool exhaustion -> upstream 502/504. makes sense as a cascade.

maya: canary rollback completed at 2026-03-15T11:42Z. canary still showing errors ~3% -> triggering full rollback. rolling back full cluster now.

deploy-bot: full rollback completed at 2026-03-15T11:48Z. Old version serving.

maya: monitoring panels now. please post any logs that look abnormal.

raj: p95/p99 trending down. p99 18s -> 1.4s over 8 minutes. error rate down to ~0.4% at 11:58Z.

support-bot: preliminary customer impact: ~12,100 failed requests during window (11:20-11:50Z). top affected orgs: org-915, org-312, org-44. CS notified and support runbook in progress.

corinne: product here — are any paid SLA customers impacted severely? need list for Exec notif.

support-bot: extracting org list and SLA tier now, will DM execs if >SLA impact.

lina: immediate mitigation actions: 1) rollback (done), 2) reduce default keepalive timeout on proxy, 3) disable kernel backlog tweak for next build, 4) add stronger canary gating (traffic & SLO gating).

raj: follow-up: add an automated alarm on connection-pool-saturation and make it page before 5xx rate crosses threshold. also add KV cache warmup heuristic on deploy.

maya: oncall handoff to paul at 12:30Z. notes -> rollback completed; metrics stabilizing; watch for resurgence for 2h. postmortem ticket created: PM-1234 (assign: lina, raj, maya).

paul: ack. i'll watch the dashboards and keep a short postmortem doc up-to-date. ping me if you see repeated tail. :eyes:

maya: adding quick reproduce snippet for the postmortem:
```txt
1) deploy with kernel backlog change + increased batch concurrency
2) under production multiplexing, kv cache misses spike (cold keys)
3) request latency increases, connections pile up -> pool saturates
4) proxy starts returning 502/504s as upstreams drop
```

lina: logging action items in PM-1234. will disable tweak and add a canary SLO gate before next rollout. also will add additional memory for kv cache in the cluster autoscaler.

maya: summary -> regression caused by deploy (v2.3.0) that changed scheduler/backlog behaviour; rollback restored previous behaviour; customer impact limited but notable (12k failed requests). we have concrete mitigations and action items.

corinne: thanks all. product will coordinate customer comms with support after final numbers.

incident-bot: incident closed -> status: mitigated at 2026-03-15T12:02Z. follow-up: postmortem due in 72h. :white_check_mark:
